name: driverUpdateProfiles
description: Windows driver update profiles with their approval type, new driver updates, reporting devices and inventory sync state (beta API)

metadata.name: syncState
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const s = $['inventorySyncStatus.driverInventorySyncState']; return s === 'success' ? 'Synced' : s === 'pending' ? 'Pending' : s === 'failure' ? 'Sync failed' : 'Unknown'; })() }}

metadata.name: lastSuccessfulSync
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['inventorySyncStatus.lastSuccessfulSyncDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}
